full_judgment: Mustafa Kamal, J.—Accused appellant Ali Akbar Khan, Mujaffar Ali Khan, Azahar Kha, Motahar Kha, Atahar Kha, Yasin Khalifa alias Esem Khalifa and Ashraf Ali Khalifa have been convicted under sections 143, 324/149 and 326/149 of the Penal Code. All the accused appellants have been sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one year each under section 148 of the Penal Code. All the accused appellants except accused appellant Ali Akbar Khan have been sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one year each under each of the counts under sections 324/149 and 326/149 of the Penal Code. The accused appellant Ali Akbar Khan has been sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for three years on each count under sections 324/149 and 326/149 of the Penal Code. All the sentences passed against the accused appellant Ali Akbar Khan shall run consecutively and all the sentences passed against the other accused appellants shall run concurrently. The aforesaid order of conviction and sentence was passed by Mr. Md. Ibrahim, the learned Assistant Sessions Judge, Second Court, Barisal by his judgment and order dated 23.12.70 in Sessions Case No. 221 of 1969.
